import argparse
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys


def _runtime():
    if shutil.which("podman"):
        return "podman"
    if shutil.which("docker"):
        return "docker"
    raise RuntimeError("Neither podman nor docker is available on PATH")


def sandbox_run(
    command: str,
    workspace: str | None = None,
    image: str = "debian:stable-slim",
    timeout: int = 60,
    network: str = "none",
    memory: str = "2g",
    pids: int = 512,
    cpus: float = 2.0,
) -> str:
    argv = [
        _runtime(), "run", "--rm", "--pull=missing",
        f"--network={network}",
        f"--memory={memory}",
        f"--pids-limit={pids}",
        f"--cpus={cpus}",
        "--cap-drop=ALL",
        "--security-opt=no-new-privileges",
    ]

    if workspace is not None:
        workspace = os.path.abspath(workspace)
        argv.extend(["-v", f"{workspace}:/workspace:rw", "-w", "/workspace"])

    argv.extend([image, "sh", "-c", command])

    try:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
        exit_code = result.returncode
        out = result.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        err = result.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        exit_code = 124
        out = ""
        err = ""

    max_bytes = 50_000
    out_bytes = out.encode("utf-8")
    err_bytes = err.encode("utf-8")
    total = len(out_bytes) + len(err_bytes)

    if total > max_bytes:
        if len(out_bytes) > max_bytes:
            out = out_bytes[:max_bytes].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            err = ""
        else:
            remaining = max_bytes - len(out_bytes)
            err = err_bytes[:remaining].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    return f"exit={exit_code}\n--- stdout ---\n{out}--- stderr ---\n{err}"


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Run commands inside an ephemeral, sandboxed container"
    )
    ap.add_argument("--image", default="debian:stable-slim")
    ap.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=60)
    ap.add_argument("--network", choices=["none", "bridge"], default="none")
    ap.add_argument("--memory", default="2g")
    ap.add_argument("--pids", type=int, default=512)
    ap.add_argument("--cpus", type=float, default=2.0)
    ap.add_argument("--workspace", default=os.getcwd())
    ap.add_argument("command", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)

    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.command and args.command[0] == "--":
        args.command = args.command[1:]

    if not args.command:
        ap.error("No command provided. Use -- COMMAND [ARG ...]")

    command = " ".join(args.command)

    output = sandbox_run(
        command=command,
        workspace=args.workspace,
        image=args.image,
        timeout=args.timeout,
        network=args.network,
        memory=args.memory,
        pids=args.pids,
        cpus=args.cpus,
    )

    sys.stdout.write(output)

    exit_line = output.split("\n", 1)[0]
    try:
        ec = int(exit_line.split("=", 1)[1])
    except (IndexError, ValueError):
        ec = 1
    sys.exit(ec)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
